scene.ko: 세일 가격이던 시리얼이 정가로 찍히고 우유가 두 번 계산된 것을 보고, 뒤에 선 줄을 신경 쓰며 정중히 바로잡는다.

lines.en: Excuse me, sorry to hold up the line, but I think the cereal rang up wrong.
lines.ko: 실례합니다, 줄을 세워 둬서 죄송한데요, 시리얼 가격이 잘못 찍힌 것 같아요.
alt: Sorry to hold everyone up, but I think the cereal was scanned wrong.
Excuse me, I think the price for the cereal is wrong.

lines.en: Oh, let me see. It came up as $5.49. What price did you see?
The sign on the shelf said it was on sale for $3.99.
alt: The shelf tag said $3.99. It was on sale.
It said $3.99 on the shelf. I thought it was on sale.

lines.en: Let me have someone check... My coworker says the sale ended yesterday. They must have forgotten to take the sign down.
lines.ko: 확인을 부탁해 볼게요... 동료 말로는 세일이 어제 끝났대요. 표지판 치우는 걸 깜빡했나 봐요.

lines.en: I see. Would you still be able to honor the sale price, since the sign was still up?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 표지판이 아직 붙어 있었으니까 그래도 세일 가격으로 해 주실 수 있을까요?
alt: Okay. Since the sign was still there, could I still get the sale price?
I understand. But the sign was up, so could you give me the sale price?

lines.en: Yes, that's our store policy. I'll change it to $3.99.
lines.ko: 네, 저희 매장 규정상 그렇게 해 드려요. 3달러 99센트로 바꿔 드릴게요.

lines.en: Thank you. Oh, and it looks like I was charged twice for the milk. I only have one.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 아, 그리고 우유가 두 번 계산된 것 같아요. 저는 하나만 샀거든요.
alt: Thanks. Also, I think the milk was scanned twice. I only have one carton.
Thank you. And the milk is on here twice, but I only got one.

lines.en: You're right, I'm so sorry. I'll take that off, too. Your new total is $41.15.
lines.ko: 맞네요, 정말 죄송합니다. 그것도 빼 드릴게요. 새 합계는 41달러 15센트입니다.

lines.en: No worries. Thanks for fixing it so quickly.
alt: No problem. Thanks for taking care of it so fast.
That's okay. Thank you for sorting it out quickly.

expressions.en: Sorry to hold up the line.
Would you still be able to honor ___?
expressions.note: honor a price = 표시된 가격대로 해 주다

expressions.en: Thanks for fixing it so quickly.
expressions.note: 문제가 해결된 뒤 하는 감사 인사
